text:
Neha Reddy: Quick sync — final marketplace launch readiness. Need owners for: hardware partner AMIs/images, SI demo flow, press embargo copy, landing page variants, localization freeze. Freeze target: Mon 2025-07-07 15:00 PT. Who's on what?

Tom Wu: I have AMIs + OVA images done. Will push to partner bucket by EOD tomorrow. Linking image list: https://redwood.tools/partners/ami-list

Elaine Park: Legal has first pass on press copy, will have redlines by Fri. Need embargo window confirmed.

Ken O'Neill: SI integration tests failing on SSO repros — seeing 403 during token exchange. Investigating with @infra. Staging logs look noisy.

Tom Wu: For SKU mapping in marketplace, use this mapping:
```yaml
sku_map:
  redwood-small: rwd-v1-small
  redwood-large: rwd-v1-large
```

Priya Malik: Marketing will deliver 2 landing variants (prod + enterprise) and localized copy for EN/FR/DE by freeze. Will also coordinate demos and one-pagers.

deploy-bot: Build #1242 for marketplace-landing succeeded :white_check_mark:

Neha Reddy: Okay assign owners: Tom => AMIs + SKU mapping; Ken => SI demo and SSO triage; Elaine => press + legal; Priya => landing + localization. We'll do dry-run Wed 2025-07-09 10:00 PT. Can everyone ack?

Tom Wu: ack :thumbsup:

Ken O'Neill: ack, blocked until SSO fix patched in staging.

Elaine Park: ack, legal will add embargo clause.

Priya Malik: ack — I'll post hero copy variants by Tue.

Neha Reddy: Thanks. If SSO not fixed by Mon, fallback plan: disable SSO in demo and note in runbook. Also add a \"demo fallback\" section.

Tom Wu: noted. Pushing SKU map to partner repo: git commit https://git.redwood.internal/partners/sku-map/commit/abc123

Ken O'Neill: I'll synchronize with SI lead @Allison to get a parallel demo path (non-SSO).

Neha Reddy: Adding last-minute checklist item: confirm press embargo time (UTC) and confirm who does embargo lift. Elaine?

Elaine Park: We're proposing embargo lift 2025-07-10T16:00Z. Recommend PR team does lift. :eyes:

Neha Reddy: Perfect. I'll update runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-launch

deploy-bot: Reminder: Schedule \"marketplace-dryrun\" meeting Wed 2025-07-09 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent.

Ken O'Neill: added a quick troubleshooting snippet for SSO:
```bash
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://staging.redwood.internal/auth/check
# check for 200 and set COOKIE
```

Priya Malik: I need screenshots for landing hero variations. Tom can you paste staging URL?

Tom Wu: staging link: https://staging.marketplace.redwood.dev/landing — creds in 1Password.

Neha Reddy: Great. We'll reconvene Tue EOD for final signoffs. Thanks all. :rocket:
